title: Engineered TtgR-Based Whole-Cell Biosensors for Quantitative and Selective Monitoring of Bioactive Compounds.
authors: Song, Kyeongseok; Ji, Haekang; Lee, Jiwon; Jang, Geupil; Yoon, Youngdae
one_liner_zh: 该文构建基于TtgR转录抑制因子的全细胞生物传感器，虽涉及TF-配体互作和分子对接，但核心是配体响应而非TF-DNA结合机制，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: TtgR, a transcriptional repressor from Pseudomonas putida, plays a key role in regulating multidrug resistance by controlling the expression of genes in response to various ligands. Despite its broad specificity, TtgR represents a promising candidate for the development of transcription factor (TF)-based biosensors. In this study, we utilized TtgR and its native promoter region (P(ttgABC)) as genetic components to construct TF-based biosensors in Escherichia coli. By coupling TtgR and P(ttgABC) with egfp, we developed a biosensor responsive to diverse flavonoids. To enhance the selectivity and specificity of the biosensor, we genetically engineered a TtgR-binding pocket. Engineered TtgR variants exhibited altered sensing profiles, enabling the development of biosensors with tailored ligand responses. Computational structural analysis and ligand docking provided insights into the interaction mechanisms between TtgR variants and flavonoids. Notably, biosensors based on wild-type TtgR and its N110F mutant were capable of quantifying resveratrol and quercetin at 0.01 mM with >90% accuracy. Although the precise molecular mechanisms involved remain unclear and further optimization is needed, the biosensors developed herein demonstrate strong potential for applications in numerous fields. This study lays the foundation for future research that could extend the utility of TtgR-based biosensors to synthetic biology, metabolic engineering, and beyond.
abstract_zh: TtgR，一种来自恶臭假单胞菌（Pseudomonas putida）的转录抑制因子，通过响应多种配体调控基因表达，在调节多药耐药性中发挥关键作用。尽管其具有广泛的底物特异性，TtgR仍是开发基于转录因子（TF）的生物传感器的有前景候选者。在本研究中，我们利用TtgR及其天然启动子区域（P(ttgABC)）作为遗传组件，在大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）中构建了基于TF的生物传感器。通过将TtgR和P(ttgABC)与egfp偶联，我们开发了一种对多种黄酮类化合物响应的生物传感器。为提高生物传感器的选择性和特异性，我们对TtgR结合口袋进行了基因工程改造。工程化的TtgR变体表现出改变的传感谱，从而能够开发具有定制配体响应的生物传感器。计算结构分析和配体对接为TtgR变体与黄酮类化合物之间的相互作用机制提供了见解。值得注意的是，基于野生型TtgR及其N110F突变体的生物传感器能够以>90%的准确度定量检测0.01 mM的白藜芦醇和槲皮素。尽管涉及的精确分子机制尚不清楚，且需要进一步优化，但本文开发的生物传感器在众多领域显示出强大的应用潜力。本研究为未来将TtgR基生物传感器的应用扩展到合成生物学、代谢工程及其他领域奠定了基础。
